scripts.build:staging: node scripts/validate-firebase-environment.mjs staging .env.staging && vite build --mode staging
scripts.build:production: node scripts/validate-firebase-environment.mjs production .env.production && vite build --mode production
scripts.deploy:staging:hosting: npm run build:staging && node scripts/deploy-firebase.mjs staging hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:production && node scripts/deploy-firebase.mjs production hosting
scripts.test: node --test printer-bridge/test/*.test.js quality/test/*.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s quality/test -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:baseline && npm run lint:baseline && npm run test && npm run build
